# Engångseffekter lyfter H&M:s resultat – Dormy börsnoteras

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon episode about H&M's Q3 report. The operating profit beat expectations, but mostly because of one-off effects, while underlying sales stayed weak (+1% in the quarter and in September) and external headwinds are expected ahead. The episode also covers the Dormy IPO, Riksbanken's expected unchanged rate decision with possible hikes in Q4, and rising US yields. Handelsbanken's broker is positive on the market overall, on Nordic AI/data-centre plays like UPM, ABB and Atlas Copco, and on Clas Ohlson, where Handelsbanken started coverage with a buy.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Handelsbanken initiated coverage with buy, target 520 SEK; guest calls it undervalued with rising profitability.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Handelsbanken) buy with 520 SEK target (~25% upside), echoed by Handelsbanken guest Robin Gartner: strong market position, profitability on the rise, excellent management under Kristofer Tonström, continued organic growth. Guest has a conflict of interest since his firm issued the rec.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic sales growth stalls
- if margin improvement reverses
- if price reaches 520 SEK target

> *"Vi startade med en köp och vi tycker att den är undervärderad."*

---

### 🟡 HM-B — H&M | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken downgraded after a 50% run; weak sales and upcoming external headwinds, but Persson family buying supports the stock.

#### Reasoning

Q3 beat mostly driven by one-offs; sales +1% weak, Germany (15-16% of sales) soft, FX/freight tailwinds turning to headwinds, more tech investment. Guest Robin lowered view after ~50% rally; almost no analysts have buy. Persson family buying (~70% owned) means no need to sell either.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth remains ~1% or turns negative
- if external headwinds hit margins harder than expected
- if Persson family stops buying

> *"en signal om att man kanske inte behöver sälja heller utan att det kommer tuffa på."*

---

### 🟢 UPM — UPM | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken sees UPM as very interesting case for data-centre PPAs; energy share could rise from ~30% toward 50%.

#### Reasoning

Following the Fortum-Google PPA, Robin says UPM is in concrete talks with hyperscalers and smaller data centres about PPAs, which would give a stable EBIT base; energy division could grow from ~30% to ~50% of business.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no PPA deals materialise
- if Nordic power prices collapse

> *"Där tycker vi att UPM är ett väldigt intressant case."*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

In the right segment (electrification/automation, data centres); investors prefer to stay with trend despite strong YTD run.

#### Reasoning

Robin: ABB in exactly right segment with electrification and automation, new data-centre portfolio launched, data-centre power demand expected to double; no slowdown in US hyperscaler capex. Already best OMX30 performer this year, which is a valuation risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US hyperscaler capex slows
- if data-centre update disappoints

> *"Men de är i helt rätt segment med elektrifieringen och automatiseringen."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Quality company with stable margins, VT division exposed to AI trend; can't expect all cylinders firing every quarter.

#### Reasoning

Cited as a Nordic quality name foreign investors favour: low debt, stable margins, fantastic Q2, VT division within AI trend. Tempered expectations for next quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- if VT division demand weakens
- if margins deteriorate

> *"Bolag som Atlas Copco, jättefint bolag, stabila marginaler, hade en fantastisk Q2."*

---

### 🟡 GETI-B — Getinge | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto downgraded from buy to hold; shares down ~2%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst action only (Pareto buy->hold); no further discussion by hosts or guests.

> *"Getinge handlas ner 1,7 procent tillbehåll från köp. Det är från Pareto."*

---

### 🟠 ARJO-B — Arjo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

CMD targets +350m SEK EBIT by mid-2029; guest wants a concrete margin plan, profitability too volatile.

#### Reasoning

Growth ~5% historically but profitability too erratic. Robin wants a concrete plan and timeline for margin improvement or cost programme; limited news at CMD; stock reversed to -2%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin plan lacks concrete timeline
- if EBIT improvement target slips

> *"Men det är lönsamheten i det här bolaget som är alldeles för slagig."*
